scope: Consumes evaluated evidence; does not certify a caller-entered report or subjective observation. Targeted feedback never establishes complete PR acceptance.

rows.reason: Exports the exact required DTO fields, initializers/data classes, typed submission, wire format and component API; private product helpers reside in this file. D0 successfully rendered this production component; this is source/API evidence, not a fresh compile.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Draft initializes no selection, requested count, credit/acceptance/sent false inside component state. Reconciliation returns existing state for identical request/revision and resets through initial(model) for a different request.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Iterates caller option order and stable IDs, resolves only available options, disables unavailable/sent buttons, ignores selecting the current ID and clears acceptance on changed selection.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Selection and revision reconciliation clamp current count to inclusive bounds. Each guarded action changes by one and clears acceptance. Native buttons disable with no valid choice, at the relevant bound or after send.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Uses Int cents for price times servings minus prepaid minus applied credit. Currency helper uses ASCII dollar/decimal with two digits and no grouping; negative balance uses absolute money and Refund, zero uses No balance due. Display derives from current model.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Credit starts false, is available for positive credit before send independently of selection, toggling clears acceptance, and revision reconciliation forces false when offered credit becomes zero.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Selection, count and credit changes plus revision clear acceptance. Switch requires a valid selection and unsent state; send additionally requires acceptance and an unsent valid selection.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Same request/new revision retains only a still available option ID, clamps current servings, retains only positive offered credit and clears accepted/sent. UI uses new model fields immediately at the stable call site; no .id/key recreation.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Only the send handler calls onSubmit with current model request/revision, selected ID, current count/credit/signed balance, then marks sent; all edit and reconciliation paths are silent and guards block resending.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Reviewed source base roles: eyebrow 12/500, title 28/700, detail/context 13/400, section 18/600, body 15/400, option title 15/600, amount 26/700, button 16/600 and count 20/600. Native system fonts; Swift uses iOS-14 ScaledMetric and Compose uses sp, without a scale cap. These are source declarations, not computed runtime styles.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Non-scrolling vertical flow preserves all text. Source uses outer 16, sections 20, card padding 12/radius16/border1/gap8, option gap8, paragraph gap10, footer16 and root radius20 in native units; wrapping has no line limit/ellipsis/fixed text height.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Actual option control labels have min height64, quantity min width/height44, send min height52 and horizontal16/vertical14 padding. Text can grow vertically and quantity buttons share one row with a flexible wrapping count.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Every light/dark role matches the public palette and is selected from caller theme. Cards remain solid surfaces, selected options use selection/accent, unavailable titles/details use secondary, refunds accent, enabled/disabled send colors are explicit; no complete-row opacity.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Uses native leading/start alignment and native horizontal flow, never forces LTR/RTL or reverses caller arrays. Quantity uses normal integer interpolation and money retains required ASCII formatting.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Production container/child IDs are unique, options have one actual native button with exact title label/selected state, and credit/acceptance are actual native switches with labels/state. Summary preserves child targets, last note has its ID, and no hidden product clone or test style readback exists.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility

rows.reason: Fixed bridge decodes the current immutable DTO and directly calls the imported production component at one stable call site; it forwards submission.wireValue without selection/count/money/revision state or keyed recreation.
rows.attribution: unassessed; evidence compatibility is not proof of defect responsibility
